name: Andrealphus
source:
When Raphael killed all his family and friends, he cut Andrealphus' both eyes and neck, but Andrealphus managed to survive. Since then, it has been his goal to kill all angels.

He cannot see, so he stuck the wings and feathers he ripped from angels onto his body as decoration, and holds a scythe he took from an angel with the halos he ripped from angel heads to provoke the angels to call them and hunt them down.
